name: claude-dock
description: Lore - a clean, minimal dock of AI assistant sessions for macOS
author: Matthew Molinar
//: electron is a runtime dependency, not a devDependency, because `npx claude-dock` must be able to launch it. That rules out electron-builder, which refuses to package an app with electron in dependencies. The published tarball ships prebuilt out/ (see prepack). src/main/dock, src/preload, src/renderer, and src/shared are synced from the Lore desktop app (tanagram/lore apps/desktop) — upstream changes arrive as automated PRs.
